prova:
exact fun k hk => by
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < ↑k := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by
      have hge : 1 ≤ k := by
        have h5 : 5 ≤ k := by linarith
        linarith
      omega)
  have hsum : ∑' n, (σ k n : ℝ) / (n ! : ℝ) = ∑' n, (1 : ℝ) / (n ! : ℝ) := by
    have hsig : ∀ n, (σ k n : ℝ) = 1 := by
      intro n
      have h : k ≤ 0 := by
        have h5 : 5 ≤ k := by linarith
        omega
      simp [h]
    refine tsum_congr (fun n => ?_)
    rw [hsig n]
  rw [hsum]
  have hexp : ∑' n, (1 : ℝ) / (n ! : ℝ) = Real.exp 1 := by
    rw [Real.exp_def]
    <;> simp only [tsum_one_div]
  rw [hexp]
  exact Real.exp_one_irrational
